name: pixel-art-studio
title_zh: 每个像素都由 Python 亲手落下的角色与动画工坊
tagline_zh: 不装 Aseprite、不配 MCP，Claude 直接当画师。能出角色、瓦片、待机/走路/攻击动画。
tagline_en: No Aseprite, no MCP—Claude draws pixel-by-pixel via Pillow. Sprites, tiles, idle/walk/run/attack anims, limited.
desc_en: Claude IS the pixel artist — designs and places every pixel directly via Python/Pillow (scripts/pixelstudio.py). No Aseprite, no MCP server. Creates sprites, characters, items, tiles/tilesets, animations (idle/walk/run/attack), applies limited palettes, hue-shifted ramps, dithering, shading, selective outlines, and exports PNG / animated GIF / spritesheet+JSON for game engines. Can also STUDY a pi
why_zh: 像素不是贴图拼的，是脚本逐点算的——色带、抖动、选择性描边都有确定规则，改一个参数整组重渲。
why_en: Pixels are computed, not pasted—ramps, dithering, and selective outlines follow deterministic rules. Tweak one param, re-render.
limit_zh: 只认 Pillow 脚本管线，不读 PSD/Aseprite 源文件；动画只覆盖待机/走/跑/攻击四类。
limit_en: Pillow-script only; no PSD/Aseprite import. Anims limited to idle/walk/run/attack; skeletal or hand-drawn frames need other tools. Output stops at.
title_en: Pixel art & animation, every pixel placed by Python
